observations: Photo 0: Front view of a white industrial sewing machine on a metal table with a red foot pedal. The machine has a digital display and control knobs. A thread stand with spools is mounted on the right side.
Photo 1: Same angle as photo 0, slightly different lighting. The machine's digital display is lit blue. The table has a ruler along the edge. The foot pedal is visible.
Photo 2: Side view showing the machine's profile. The red foot pedal is on the left. The table has a metal frame with red feet. The background shows a wall with a remote control and switches.
Photo 3: Front view from a slightly different angle. The machine is on the table. The foot pedal is visible. The table has a ruler. The background includes a door and a curtain.
All photos show the same machine and table setup. No visible damage to the machine or table. The machine appears clean and well-maintained.

claims.claim: Japanese made, the motor runs smooth. All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.
